not_substitutes: TOTAL_HARD_APPROX without explicit new approximation decision

cube_serialization.authoritative_coordinates: authored input/engine coordinate state, not rounded CUBE header
cube_serialization.grid_policy: Validate rounded metadata against source axes/origin with serialization error budget; do not apply A01 1e-25m input-equivalence threshold to CUBE metadata.

reference_constants_policy.export_conversion_candidate: Use explicit engine-native conversion to common SI; record edition/values for each engine profile. No hidden patch to engine constants. A04 must freeze actual binary profile and conversion policy.
reference_constants_policy.nuclear_mass_policy: Preserve explicit A01 CODATA2022 bare nuclear masses in kg; convert to engine mass units using pinned engine atomic_mass_kg instead of accepting default neutral atomic mass.

acceptance: A03/P2 compare full-density integrals and refine grids; report negative lobes/truncation error; never clip, smooth or normalize data just to pass.
